split_focus: MEDITECH EHI Export Configuration 2 — sites using Medical Records Imaging (MRI) and Data Repository (DR) modules. Exports: Patient Data as CSV files + US Core FHIR R4 data + C-CDA documents + supplemental clinical/administrative/financial reports and images. Applicable platforms: 6.08/MPM (ambulatory only), Client/Server (acute & ambulatory), MAGIC (acute & ambulatory). Each platform has its own CSV data dictionary PDF: Client/Server uses csacuteandambehiexportdrsolutionmerged.pdf, MAGIC uses mgehiexportdrsolutionmerged.pdf, 6.08/MPM ambulatory uses 608ehiexportcsv.pdf. Focus your analysis on the Config 2 specification page (ehiexportconfig2.html), the platform-specific CSV data dictionary PDFs, and the main overview (ehiexport-main.html). Evaluate what data each platform's CSV export covers, differences between platforms, and completeness of EHI coverage.
